en: A black and white image showing a large, elegant European square or park surrounded by ornate, historic multi-story buildings in a grand architectural style. The scene includes men in formal clothing and women with parasols and prams, typical of turn-of-the-20th-century attire. The park is landscaped with paths, fencing, and planted trees, and there is a sense of urban sophistication and civic order.
